mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS userId, u.nickname AS nickname, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.status = 2 THEN s.problem_id END) AS solved, COUNT(s.id) AS submitCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN s.status = 2 THEN 1 END) AS acceptCount FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN submission s ON s.user_id = u.id WHERE u.deleted = 0 AND u.role = 0 GROUP BY u.id, u.nickname ORDER BY solved DESC, submitCount ASC, u.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT contest_id AS contestId, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS participants FROM submission WHERE contest_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY contest_id

SELECT #{userId} AS userId, NULL AS nickname, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.status = 2 THEN s.problem_id END) AS solved, COUNT(s.id) AS submitCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN s.status = 2 THEN 1 END) AS acceptCount FROM submission s WHERE s.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT s.user_id AS userId, COUNT(s.id) AS submitCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN s.status = 2 THEN 1 END) AS acceptCount FROM submission s GROUP BY s.user_id
